nodes.label: theme.ts Color Usage Rule (no inline hex)
nodes.norm_label: theme.ts color usage rule (no inline hex)

nodes.label: Open Technical Decisions (useReducer vs zustand, dnd-kit, Vitest, score location, snapshot scope)
nodes.norm_label: open technical decisions (usereducer vs zustand, dnd-kit, vitest, score location, snapshot scope)

nodes.label: <SelectionOverlay> Single Overlay Div
nodes.rationale: Frame movement updates only one div's grid-area/transform instead of re-rendering 100 cells.

nodes.label: DOM + CSS Grid Rendering Constraint (no Canvas, single overlay div)
nodes.norm_label: dom + css grid rendering constraint (no canvas, single overlay div)
nodes.rationale: Avoid re-rendering cells on move; selection frame is one overlay div.

nodes.label: Pointer Events Input Constraint (no HTML5 DnD, touch-action: none)
nodes.norm_label: pointer events input constraint (no html5 dnd, touch-action: none)

nodes.label: DOM + CSS Grid Rendering Decision
nodes.rationale: Only 100 cells and no real-time render loop; cell-level drawing handles cut or holed shapes without renderer changes.

nodes.label: Pointer Events Input Decision
nodes.rationale: Single code path for mouse and touch; HTML5 Drag&Drop lacks touch support.

nodes.label: Touch Handling Requirements (touch-action, finger offset, grab offset, arithmetic hit-test)
nodes.norm_label: touch handling requirements (touch-action, finger offset, grab offset, arithmetic hit-test)
nodes.rationale: Without touch-action none drags become page scroll; arithmetic pointer-to-cell avoids DOM lookups.

nodes.label: React Compiler (disabled)
nodes.rationale: Not enabled due to its impact on dev and build performance.

nodes.label: Pure Core Constraint (no React in src/core)
nodes.norm_label: pure core constraint (no react in src/core)
nodes.rationale: Core game logic must be pure TypeScript so it can be tested without a browser and survive renderer changes.

nodes.label: core/ Separation Principle (folder structure)
nodes.rationale: Logic verifiable without a browser, undecided params testable via config, logic survives renderer swaps.

nodes.label: Favicon (default Vite lightning-bolt logo)
nodes.rationale: Unmodified Vite scaffold asset: purple/blue gradient lightning bolt with blurred ellipse glow; not yet branded to the Shape Spider wood/gold theme and uses raw hex colors outside theme.ts

nodes.label: Tap -> Drag -> Confirm Interaction
nodes.rationale: Double-click excluded because it conflicts with mobile zoom.

nodes.label: Action List (DRAW_HAND, PLACE_PIECE, PASS_HAND, REBUILD_DECK, *_SELECTION, UNDO)
nodes.norm_label: action list (draw_hand, place_piece, pass_hand, rebuild_deck, *_selection, undo)

nodes.label: Board (rows, cols, cells[])
nodes.rationale: 1D array keeps immutable updates (cells.with) simple and index math maps directly to coordinates.

nodes.label: Cell ({color, pieceId} | null)
nodes.rationale: pieceId stored only to render faint inner seams between same-color pieces; rules use color only.

nodes.label: Snapshot (one-step undo)
nodes.rationale: Undo is single-step so snapshots are not nested (Omit prev and selection).

nodes.label: Game State Flow (draw, place, pass, rebuild, extract)
nodes.norm_label: game state flow (draw, place, pass, rebuild, extract)

nodes.label: Deck & Hand Rule (fixed order, 5-card hand, pass whole hand)
nodes.norm_label: deck & hand rule (fixed order, 5-card hand, pass whole hand)

nodes.label: Piece Catalog (9 shapes: I3, L3, I, O, T, S, Z, J, L)
nodes.norm_label: piece catalog (9 shapes: i3, l3, i, o, t, s, z, j, l)

nodes.label: Scoring Rule (cells x10, -50 per rebuild, +2000 clear, floor 0)
nodes.norm_label: scoring rule (cells x10, -50 per rebuild, +2000 clear, floor 0)

nodes.label: No Magic Numbers (all settings via GameConfig)
nodes.norm_label: no magic numbers (all settings via gameconfig)

nodes.label: 1D Board Array (index = r * cols + c)
nodes.rationale: Board is managed per cell, never per piece, because square extraction cuts placed pieces.

nodes.label: Balance Numbers (target 3~6, 140-card deck)
nodes.rationale: 3~8 needs 796 cells (~160 cards, 32+ turns); 3~6 needs 344 cells so deck is 35 per color with waste margin. 3~8 kept as hard mode.

nodes.label: Cell-Level Ownership Board Model
nodes.rationale: Square extraction cuts placed pieces, so a piece-level model cannot hold.

nodes.label: Deck Rebuild (no shuffle, penalty per rebuild)
nodes.norm_label: deck rebuild (no shuffle, penalty per rebuild)
nodes.rationale: Penalty discourages excessive passing; passing more exhausts the deck faster, causing more rebuilds.

nodes.label: No Rotation / Reflection Rule
nodes.rationale: Without rotation, S/Z and J/L become meaningfully distinct shapes.

nodes.label: Undo Rule (1 step, no consecutive, pass not undoable)
nodes.norm_label: undo rule (1 step, no consecutive, pass not undoable)
nodes.rationale: Undoing a hand pass would reveal the next 5 cards, giving an information advantage.

nodes.label: findExtractPositions()
nodes.rationale: Worst case (11-N)^2 x N^2 checks, under 10k for N=3..8, so safe to run every frame; recompute only on cell-level anchor change.

nodes.label: hasAnyPlacement()
nodes.rationale: Checks the whole deck (hand + pending + recycled), not the hand, since the hand can always be passed.

nodes.label: Game End Conditions (victory, stuck, stall, forfeit)
nodes.norm_label: game end conditions (victory, stuck, stall, forfeit)

nodes.label: Placement Rule (in bounds, no overlap, permanent)
nodes.norm_label: placement rule (in bounds, no overlap, permanent)

nodes.label: Square Collection Rule (3x3 -> 6x6 per color, color-only judgment)
nodes.norm_label: square collection rule (3x3 -> 6x6 per color, color-only judgment)

nodes.label: Destination-Based Selection Rule Constraint
nodes.rationale: Selection logic separated as (board, startCell, dest) -> Coord[] so the destination decides the rule.

nodes.label: Principle: Destination Determines Selection Rule
nodes.rationale: Removes highlight ambiguity; collection = next NxN of color (user picks position), storage = whole connected group (automatic). Adding storage = adding one function.

nodes.label: User-Chosen Extraction Position
nodes.rationale: Choosing where to pull an NxN (e.g. 20 positions for 4x4 in 7x8) is the strategic core.

nodes.label: Infinite Loop Prevention (Stall)
nodes.rationale: A full cycle after rebuild with zero placements ends the game, since rebuild count has no cap.
